name: s0_tokenizers
caption: Round-trip integrity (decode(encode(x)) == x) for every generator tokenizer across ASCII, Unicode, whitespace and long-repetition probes, plus exactness of the tail operation the sliding window relies on. A failure invalidates W for that model.
